# Fenod Stack

> Agent-first Cloudflare TypeScript stack. Stack Contract is law. Proof: examples/smoke.

## Read first

- Agent entry: AGENTS.md
- Stack Contract: docs/stack-contract.md
- Agent Operating Contract: docs/agent-operating-contract.md

- Recipes: docs/recipes.md
- Astro content sites: docs/astro.md
- New project: docs/new-project.md
- Security Model: docs/security-model.md
- Agent Factory: docs/agent-factory.md
- Error Design: docs/errors.md
- Review Guide: docs/review-guide.md

## Route by task

- **upgrade existing project / guarded main / rollback / legacy Alchemy** → UPGRADING.md, docs/recipes.md, plans/012-existing-project-rollout.md
- **Astro / content site / SEO / JSON-LD / responsive images** → docs/astro.md, examples/astro/README.md, examples/astro/package.json
- **client content editing / CMS / EmDash / draft preview / publishing** → docs/astro-emdash.md, docs/astro.md, docs/security-model.md
- **Cloudflare CLI / cf migration / Alchemy 2 / infrastructure lifecycle** → docs/cloudflare-tooling.md, docs/agent-operating-contract.md, skills/fenod-cloudflare-deploy/SKILL.md
- **new project / getting started / first deploy / repo and Cloudflare setup** → docs/new-project.md, examples/smoke/README.md, docs/environment-secrets.md
- **new app / architecture / stack choice** → docs/stack-contract.md, skills/fenod-stack/SKILL.md, examples/smoke/STACK.md
- **deploy / Cloudflare / secrets / D1 migration** → docs/agent-operating-contract.md, docs/security-model.md, skills/fenod-cloudflare-deploy/SKILL.md
- **AI feature / coding agent / eval / sandbox** → docs/agent-factory.md, docs/agent-evals.md, docs/security-model.md
- **auth / permissions / sensitive data** → docs/security-model.md, docs/agent-operating-contract.md, examples/smoke/src/lib/auth.ts
- **test / lint / typecheck / refactor** → skills/fenod-quality/SKILL.md, examples/smoke/package.json
- **UI / shadcn component or block** → docs/recipes.md, skills/fenod-stack/SKILL.md, examples/smoke/components.json, examples/smoke/oxlint.config.ts
- **slow data loading / D1 N+1 / Router cache** → docs/recipes.md, docs/gotchas.md, docs/security-model.md
- **TanStack Start / D1 reference** → examples/smoke/STACK.md, examples/smoke/package.json
- **errors / error messages / HTTP status / retry** → docs/errors.md
- **PR / review packet / completion report** → docs/review-guide.md, docs/agent-operating-contract.md
- **Effect lane (project STACK.md says Lane: effect)** → docs/effect-lane.md, docs/errors.md, docs/review-guide.md

## Core defaults

Node 24, pnpm, TanStack Start on Cloudflare Workers, static Astro for developer-maintained marketing/content; Astro+EmDash candidate for client editing with a bounded CMS database/auth exception and pilot gate, Start server functions first then Hono+ORPC when needed, Drizzle 0.4x+D1, Better Auth, Tailwind v4+shadcn/ui, Wrangler baseline; optional cf beta toolbox and conditional Alchemy 2 pinned pilot, Infisical+Worker secrets, Oxlint+Oxfmt+@shadcn/lint, TypeScript 7 tsc, Vitest, Playwright.

## Verification

Handbook root: `pnpm check && pnpm test`. Reference apps: `pnpm --dir examples/smoke ship` and `pnpm --dir examples/astro ship`. Product repos: `pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test` (add build/browser checks for higher risk).
